approval_source.reference: Brief P1g4: macOS 27 update in the row-3 baseline check; wiki decisions 2026-10-19: please answer them yourself
approval_source.evidence: Gary updated his own Mac; the coordinator accepts the update on Gary's delegation recorded in the 2026-10-19 wiki decisions (please answer them yourself), as supplied by Brief P1g4. The frozen Mac machine records kernel 25.6.0 and os macOS 26.6.2. On 2026-10-19, uname -r and the checker's platform.release() return 27.0.0; sw_vers ProductVersion and the checker's platform.mac_ver()[0] return 27.0.1. sw_vers BuildVersion returns 26A434. baseline.json and the live collector do not record a macOS build field, so the build is evidence only. Brief P1g4 reports the remaining gate checks pass, including the existing serving-stack amendment. No other Mac machine or collection change is authorized.

scope: baseline.json mac.machine.kernel and mac.machine.os only, as the complete recorded pair from the macOS 27 update; all other Mac machine and physical collection facts remain strict under the existing checker and separately approved serving-stack amendment. The frozen baseline remains unchanged.
